blocks.content: A small っ signals a short, sharp pause before the following consonant, which is then held slightly longer. It occupies one full mora : one beat of rhythm : like any other kana.

lines: → the pause doubles the following consonant

blocks.content: Common mistake: without the っ, the meaning changes entirely. きて (*kite*) = "come!" : completely different from きって (*kitte*, postage stamp). Treat っ as a real beat of silence, not an ornament.
